0.6.1 is a drop-in patch for 0.6.0: format epoch 2 is unchanged, with no storage, snapshot or Raft protocol change. Upgrade from 0.6.0 in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`); no fresh install or data move is needed.

- **Fixed:** `ursulactl` no longer counts a memory-WAL voter that restarted with an empty log as ready, so a prepared rollout rebuilds it instead of continuing on two real copies.
- **Fixed:** the leadership balancer hands a group only to a peer that has matched the leader's log.
- **Fixed:** the restart fence waits out a leadership transfer that was accepted just before it.
- **Known issue (not fixed):** after an unplanned restart of a memory-WAL node (crash, OOM kill, eviction), run `ursulactl verify-cluster` and, if it reports the node unready, `ursulactl repair-restarted-voter --node N`. Production clusters must use the disk WAL.

Details are in the [0.6.1 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#061); memory-WAL restarts are described in [Restarting a memory-WAL node](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/operations#restarting-a-memory-wal-node).
